taste:
Stella Artois is a crisp Belgian-style lager with gentle malt sweetness, subtle floral hop aromas and a bitter finish. The balance is clean rather than dominated by sweetness, with the bitterness providing a sharp closing note. Its bright, pale golden colour and thick white head give you a clear idea of the style before the first sip.

Served chilled on draught, it has high carbonation that keeps the drinking texture lively and refreshes the palate between mouthfuls. That sharpness is useful alongside battered cod and chips or spicy chicken dishes, where the lager's crisp finish provides a contrast to richness and stronger flavours.
